summary_en: KJ005 Corporation's tender offer for Taiyoh Holdings shares, initially planned for early October 2026, is being rescheduled to late November 2026 pending completion of antitrust and investment regulatory approvals in China and Japan.
title_en: Notice of Change in Scheduled Commencement Date of Tender Offer for Shares of Taiyoh Holdings Co., Ltd. (Equity Method Affiliate) by KJ005 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
This is a status update on an MBO transaction previously announced by DIC Corporation. KJ005 Corporation, a subsidiary of KJ005HD Corporation (ultimately controlled by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P.), is conducting a tender offer for Taiyoh Holdings Co., Ltd., a related company of DIC accounted for using the equity method, with the aim of acquiring the target company and delisting it from the market.

The tender offer was originally scheduled to commence in early October 2026, subject to obtaining necessary regulatory clearances under antitrust laws and foreign investment regulations in multiple jurisdictions. As of October 9, 2026, approvals have been obtained in Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia, Vietnam, and from the U.S. CFIUS. However, clearances from China's antitrust authorities and Japan's foreign investment review process remain incomplete.

KJ005 Corporation now targets completion of the remaining regulatory procedures by November 2026, with a view to commencing the tender offer in late November 2026. The bidder has also clarified that certain jurisdictions initially listed (Spain, Israel) no longer require pre-clearance, while Korea's procedure has been reclassified from pre-clearance to post-clearance. Further announcements will be made as conditions are satisfied or should the timeline change.
